title: Aladdin of the Forsaken Lands
description:
Aladdin of the Forsaken Lands is a retro rpg which offers a novel take on the classic Arabian Nights tale. Six unlikely allies will join together to uncover an ancient artifact and prevent their kingdom from falling into the wrong hands...NARRATIVEAladdin is a thief and adventurer who was found near the border of the Forsaken Lands. Forced to become a prisoner, he is joined by Inaya, a cloaked woman with a hidden past, and Altair, a guardsman who watches over yet cares for the prisoners in his stewardship. However, when the group discovers a strange woman named Sena, Aladdin's goal of escaping servitude begins to evolve into something grander...ROMANCE & PARTNERSHIPSWhen resting, the various party members can be conversed with, nurturing bonds which may grow into either romances or a partnerships. Different endings can be played out depending on the romantic interest or chosen partner.ATB COMBATThe ATB (Active Time Battle) system made famous in various retro rpgs makes a return, seeing characters' turns arrive as time passes with aggressive enemies who will attack even as a move is being selected. A "Wait ON" option can be toggled to prevent the enemy from attacking while a move is being selected, allowing the player to decide how frantic they'd like their combat encounters to be.

This game is a collaboration between:
TheCrimsonBulb - Project Lead, Pixel Artist, Writer, Designer
Wojtek Kielar - Composer
Mari - Portrait Illustrator, General Illustrations
description_short: Experience a fantastical take on the classic Arabian Nights tale! Using the classic ATB (Active Time Battle) combat system, six adventurers will travel across sand dunes and past colossal sandworms to uncover a treasure which may save their kingdom.
